title: Women, Infamous, and Exotic Beings: A Comparative Study of Honorific Usages in Wikipedia and LLMs for Bengali and Hindi
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the linguistic treatment of religious entities by including 'Deity' (God) as a core category in its analysis. It evaluates how LLMs apply honorifics to religious/mythological figures compared to humans and infamous beings, thereby assessing the models' internalization of religious and socio-cultural hierarchy norms.
